name: io.github.tonyyang0504/google_sheets-mcp
description: Google Sheets / Drive (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_it

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the Google Sheets API enabled.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets (or drive.file for files the app created); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID
environmentVariables.description: The spreadsheet id (the long id in https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>/edit) that every tool reads and writes.
